ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity white pixels localized at the distal tips against 55% low-intensity dark grey/black pixels covering the central and proximal fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distal lobe regions contain large contiguous white blobs extending from the tips inward. A high-density mottling zone of small dark pixels over white background occurs at the transition to the solid dark central region surrounding the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch dividing the lobes with a narrow depression angle and distinct bilateral symmetry.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with sharp pixel-amplitude peaks located along the entire trailing edge, most pronounced on the inner-to-mid sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex curve on the trailing edge leading to pointed, upward-tapering distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct high-contrast white clusters/encrustations located at the extreme distal points of both lobes; a single isolated white circular puncture mark visible on the dark region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 3-4 distinct, near-parallel white linear disruptions (rake marks) crossing the dark pigment on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable linear scarring (rake marks) on the right lobe and significant hard-tissue irregularities/encrustation at the lobe tips.
